title: Scalable Ground-State Certification of Quantum Spin Systems via Structured Noncommutative Polynomial Optimization
summary: A fundamental challenge in quantum physics is determining the ground-state properties of many-body systems. Whereas standard variational approaches posit a wave-function ansatz and minimize over the possible states expressible by that ansatz, the problem can alternatively be formulated as a noncommutative polynomial optimization problem and treated through a hierarchy of semidefinite programming relaxations.
